corpus/release-checklist.txt:4:A release owner checks tests, rollout controls and rollback instructions before deployment. Record the release identifier and monitor error rates during the rollout. Pause when the release causes unexpected impact. Release ownership and service ownership are related operational concerns but are not customer refund approval roles. An application team can deliver a change to Beacon while Platform remains accountable for the service. Use the service register for that accountability rather than the last person who changed a file.
corpus/incident-runbook.txt:4:For a production incident, identify the affected service and its accountable team before paging. The incident coordinator records timestamps, decisions and customer impact. An emergency response does not itself change financial approval roles. Resolve the incident, then record follow-up work with a named owner. On-call schedules rotate weekly and the coordinator should check the current roster rather than use an old chat message. Customer refunds arising from an outage follow the customer operations handbook; do not infer a payment approver from incident command.

Document ID: service-register
Title: Service accountability register

Service accountability register, reviewed 9 October 2026.

Platform owns Beacon. Beacon delivers notifications for application teams; it is not itself a team or an approval role. Service ownership means operational accountability for reliability, access reviews and incident follow-up. It does not transfer customer refund approval rights.

The accountable team maintains the service runbook and decides how incident work is assigned. To identify its team lead, consult the leadership directory. On-call participation and team leadership are separate responsibilities. Application developers may contribute changes without becoming owners.
Document ID: leadership-directory
Title: Engineering leadership directory

Engineering leadership directory.

Elena Park leads Platform. The team covers service reliability, developer infrastructure and operational tooling. The leader is accountable for team planning; current on-call assignments are recorded in the incident rota.

Engineering team leads do not automatically hold finance approval roles. When investigating a service, start from its accountable team in the service register, then consult this directory. A service name and a person's informal project involvement are not sufficient to infer ownership.
